name: team game prop line splits by week under a week row axis (executed-result parity)
description: Seed a player on team ZTA with a DraftKings CLOSE GAME_TOTAL market on ZTA's 2023 REG week 1 game (44.5) and a different line on its week 2 game (51.5), then request the column with single_nfl_week_id naming BOTH weeks under a year+week row axis. Each week row must carry its own week's total. team_betting_market_with pinned the markets CTE to a single scalar week and team_betting_market_join correlated on team alone -- the same pair fixed for the player game props in fc4a84ca0. The player maps to the game's home/away teams through player_year_teams (gamelog rows seed team ZTA for 2023), so the joined team is that of the row's year; the two-season switch has its own fixture (team-game-prop-team-attribution).
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2023 AND nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1, 2)), "player_week_appearances" as (select "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week", "nfl_games"."esbid" as "esbid", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team" as "nfl_team" from "player_gamelogs" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "player_gamelogs"."esbid" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023) and "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2023)), "player_week_teams" as (select "pid", "year", "week", "esbid", "nfl_team", max(nfl_team) over (partition by pid, year, appearance_group) as nfl_team_most_recent from (select "spine_players"."pid", "spine"."year", "spine"."week", "week_appearance"."esbid", "week_appearance"."nfl_team", count(week_appearance.nfl_team) over (partition by spine_players.pid, spine.year order by spine.week rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as appearance_group from (select distinct "player_gamelogs"."pid", "player_gamelogs"."season_year" as "year" from "player_gamelogs" where "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2023)) as "spine_players" inner join (select distinct "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023) and "nfl_games"."week" in (1, 2)) as "spine" on "spine"."year" = "spine_players"."year" left join "player_week_appearances" as "week_appearance" on "week_appearance"."pid" = "spine_players"."pid" and "week_appearance"."year" = "spine"."year" and "week_appearance"."week" = "spine"."week") as "player_week_team_spine"), "t79662a93b9f5db2a8a902870c07d643e_markets" as (select "source_id", "source_market_id", "time_type", "prop_markets_index"."esbid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week" from "prop_markets_index" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "prop_markets_index"."esbid" and "nfl_games"."season_year" = "prop_markets_index"."season_year" and nfl_games.nfl_week_id in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') where "market_type" = 'GAME_TOTAL' and "time_type" = 'CLOSE' and "source_id" = 'DRAFTKINGS' and "prop_markets_index"."season_year" in (2023)), "t79662a93b9f5db2a8a902870c07d643e" as (select distinct on ("pms"."selection_pid", "m"."esbid") "pms"."selection_pid", "m"."esbid", "m"."year", "m"."week", pms.selection_metric_line from "t79662a93b9f5db2a8a902870c07d643e_markets" as "m" inner join "prop_market_selections_index" as "pms" on "pms"."source_id" = "m"."source_id" and "pms"."source_market_id" = "m"."source_market_id" and "pms"."time_type" = "m"."time_type" where "pms"."selection_type" in ('OVER') order by "pms"."selection_pid" asc, "m"."esbid" asc, "pms"."observed_at" desc, "m"."source_market_id" asc, "pms"."selection_metric_line" asc), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t79662a93b9f5db2a8a902870c07d643e"."selection_metric_line" AS "team_game_prop_line_betting_market_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_week_teams" on "player_week_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_week_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_week_teams"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "t79662a93b9f5db2a8a902870c07d643e" on "t79662a93b9f5db2a8a902870c07d643e"."esbid" = "player_week_teams"."esbid" left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t79662a93b9f5db2a8a902870c07d643e"."selection_metric_line", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
